mysticism.skill.reducer.description:
{P}: faster aura/magicule regeneration; toggle lowers spell cost.
[Emancipation] *press*: holy hits at ×1.75 attack damage.
[Purity Edge] *press*: next hit adds 25% target max HP (50% mastered); 10,000 magicule. Hit within 3s (5s mastered) or lose 75% max HP (25% mastered).
mysticism.skill.repeater.description:
Toggle: physical hits deal a second hit.
[Recursion Depth] *press*: record hits for 5s, then deal ×1.5 their total again. Each hit after the first is 90% of the last.
[Flarefrost Storehouse] *press*: store/retrieve Axiom in main hand and Waltz in offhand.
mysticism.skill.reshiram.description:
Toggle: +150% fire boost.
[Blue Flare] *press*: 60-damage fire field, size 20, lasts 5s.
[Fusion Flare] *press*: pulling fire field, 200 damage, size 5.
[Draconic Meteor] *press*: 70 damage, 10-block blast.
[Flamethrower] *hold*: fire breath, 30 damage.
mysticism.skill.restricted.description:
{P}: stronger physical/Battlewill attacks; toggle boosts speed and armor.
[Dash] *press*: blink 12 blocks (16 mastered), striking along the path for attack damage +25 (+75 mastered). Needs ground or water.
[Counter] *press*: parry a physical hit within 3s (5s mastered), imbalancing its attacker for 5s; press again to cancel.
mysticism.skill.scholar.description:
Toggle: faster skill learning/mastery. 20% chance to study attackers, building dodge chance against that player or mob type. Unlocks all schematics.
*Press*: open enchanted-book storage to manage enchantments; allows up to 5 bonus levels.
mysticism.skill.spiritualist.description:
Harvest soul points with a scythe; spend them to boost damage.
[Summon Scythe] *press*, empty main hand: summon/dismiss.
[Carve] *press* with scythe: sweep foes within 5 blocks for soul points.
[Enhance] *hold+scroll*: set soul output (0–100%).
Toggle: faster chanting and thinking.
mysticism.skill.stagnator.description:
Stops movement and attacks.
[Stagnate Aura] *hold*: Stagnate and Silence within 25 blocks.
[Inaction] *hold*: immobilize yourself; block non-spiritual damage.
[Stasis Coat] *press*: Severance Blade I for 5s; again to remove.
[Stasis Shot] *press*: projectile, 50 damage (100 mastered).
mysticism.skill.subjugator.description:
Control eligible foes; command followers.
*Press* by mode:
[Takeover]: control within 5 blocks (10 mastered).
[Communication Movement]: group orders; *sneak+press*: one.
[Communication Targeting]: attack orders.
[Unbreakable Defense]: disables other toggles; defense benefit not checked.
[Return]: loyalty count.
[The Voice]: awakened dialogue.
In targeting mode, *sneak+scroll*: reply; *release*: send; *sneak+release*: cancel.
mysticism.skill.victorious_harbinger.des:
{P}: blocks Fear and Mind Control. Toggle: +10% attack speed.
[Might] *hold*: fear aura.
[Tenacious Resolve] *press*: harmful effects lose one level (minimum I) and 25% of remaining time. 500 magicule.
mysticism.skill.zekrom.description:
Toggle: +150% lightning boost.
[Bolt Strike] *press*: lightning, 150 damage, radius 7.5.
[Fusion Bolt] *hold, release*: dash 15 blocks, hitting for 60 damage.
[Draconic Breath] *hold*: 60-damage breath.
[Thunderbolt] *press*: lightning, 100 damage, 30-block range.
tensura.skill.absolute_severance.descrip:
Severing melee coat or flying slash.
[Severance Coat] *press*: Severance Blade V (XX mastered) for 600s; again to remove.
[Severance Cutter] *press*: 50 damage (300 mastered), size 5 (8 mastered). 20,000 magicule.
tensura.skill.analyst.description:
Toggle: faster chanting, thinking and skill learning/mastery.
[Analytical Appraisal] *press*: scan 20 blocks (25 mastered). *Sneak+press*: entities/blocks/both.
[Analyze] *hold* at a copiable magic projectile within 30 blocks: learn its spell after 5s (3s mastered; chant speed helps).
tensura.skill.berserk.description:
Toggle: ×2 fire boost; melee hits burn foes.
[Rage] *press*: Strengthen V (X mastered) for 300s; again to end.
[Mad Ogre] *press*: transform for 600s, 5,000 magicule; Rampage for 30s. Mastered: press again to fire/summon orbs (100 damage).
*Sneak+press*: end form. Mastered: *sneak* to spend an orb and halve a hit.
tensura.skill.berserker.description:
Armor, attack and speed scale with EP; mastered attack bonus doubles. Damages enemy equipment faster. Toggle boosts EP gains.
*Hold 2s*: transform.
*Hold again*: end transformation.
tensura.skill.bewilder.description:
Mind-controls eligible non-spiritual foes.
[Target] *press*: control for 600s; *sneak+press*: release.
[Area] *press*: control within 10 blocks (15 mastered) for 300s. Resistance halves control time.
[Charm] *press*: Hero of the Village V for 120s.
[Kill] *press*: controlled foes nearby take their current HP as damage (half if resistant).
tensura.skill.chef.description:
Heals missing HP, clears severance damage and removes harmful effects except skill effects. Costs 60 magicule per HP (40 mastered), 100 per effect.
*Press*: heal yourself.
*Sneak+press*: heal a target within 5 blocks.
tensura.skill.chosen_one.description:
Toggle: Hero of the Village V. Equipped: Luck V and buffs to allies within 15 blocks.
[Hero's Haki] *hold*: fear aura.
[Hero's Charisma] *press*: control eligible foes within 10 blocks for 120s (60s if resistant).
*Scroll* (mastered): Power Scale.
tensura.skill.cook.description:
Toggle: +100% crit and dodge-negation chance; faster skill learning/mastery. Hits can break multilayer barriers.
[Chaotic Fate] *press*: arm max-HP reduction on your next hit; stays active when mastered.
*Sneak+press*: restore a target's lost max HP within 6 blocks.
tensura.skill.creator.description:
Creates temporary Unique skills from the configured list.
[Analytical Appraisal] *press*: inspect targets; mastered scans 5 blocks. *Sneak+press*: entities/blocks/both.
[Skill Creation] *press*: open skill creation menu; skill lasts 60s, 60s cooldown.
tensura.skill.degenerate.description:
Craft/decraft items; absorb weakened spirits and steal skills.
[Crafting] *press*: decrafting menu; *sneak+press*: item/enchantment synthesis menu.
[Synthesise] *press*: absorb a spirit below 25% HP or a Charybdis core.
[Separate] *press*: strip eligible skills, cleanse effects or extract ores; aim at air to cleanse yourself.
tensura.skill.divine_berserker.descripti:
Ogre Berserker transformation for 180s (360s mastered); Battlewill damage ×1.5 (×2 mastered), with debuffs afterward. Costs 10,000 magicule.
*Press*: transform; again to end early.
tensura.skill.engorger.description:
Toggle: grow ×1.5, +10 armor/attack and +2.5 reach.
*Press*: Engorgement II for 120s; further presses dash with attack damage +50 (+100 mastered), from ground or water.
*Sneak+press*: also enables the skill if off.
tensura.skill.envy.description:
Toggle: +10% melee/projectile dodge; blocks Weakness and Slowness.
[Absorb] *press*: steal EP from an eligible weaker target within 5 blocks; can fail.
[Strength Sap] *hold*: Slowness/Weakness for 10s and EP drain within 15 blocks; risks Insanity.
tensura.skill.falsifier.description:
Conceals you and makes illusions.
[Presence Concealment] *press*: hide for 120s; again to end.
[Illusion] *press*: open item-illusion menu.
[Fake Death] *hold* (up to 30s): on a normal hit, leave a decoy corpse and hide for 3s.
